description: A parent needs to keep track of one child's school week, including pickup plans, supply reminders, activity days, permission slips, meal exceptions, and a few changing after-school arrangements.

user_profile.persona: 36-year-old parent juggling work and elementary school logistics
user_profile.context: The week is full of small exceptions, and forgetting just one of them creates a scramble
user_profile.communication_style: Pragmatic and schedule-oriented, wants one compact weekly view

fact_sheet.fact: The child's name is Leo Miller.
Leo Miller attends Maplewood Elementary School.
Leo Miller is in Grade 2, in classroom 104.
Leo's homeroom teacher is Ms. Anya Sharma.
Ms. Sharma's email address is a.sharma@maplewood.edu.
The school nurse, Carol Davis, can be reached at extension 102.
Leo Miller has a severe allergy to peanuts.
An EpiPen for Leo is located in the nurse's office in a clearly labeled red pouch.
Friday, October 18th is Pizza Day, costing $5.00, which has already been paid online.
A signed permission slip for the Green Meadow Farm field trip is due on Friday, October 18th.
Leo needs to bring a box of 24 'Crayola' brand crayons for a class art project by Thursday, October 17th.
Leo must bring an old, oversized t-shirt to use as an art smock on Wednesday, October 16th.
Monday, October 14th, is a standard school day from 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM.
Tuesday, October 15th, is Gym day, and Leo needs to wear sneakers.
Wednesday, October 16th, is Art class with Mrs. Gable.
Thursday, October 17th, is Library day, and Leo's two books are due for return.
Friday, October 18th, is an early dismissal day, with school ending at 1:00 PM.
On Monday, October 14th, Leo will be picked up at 3:00 PM by his mother, Sarah Miller.
On Tuesday, October 15th, Leo will be picked up at 4:15 PM from the soccer field by his grandfather, David Chen.
On Wednesday, October 16th, Leo will be picked up by his friend Sam's father, Tom Davis, for a playdate.
On Thursday, October 17th, Leo will be picked up at 3:00 PM by his grandfather, David Chen.
On Friday, October 18th, Leo will be picked up at 1:00 PM by his mother, Sarah Miller.
Leo has after-school soccer club on Tuesday from 3:15 PM to 4:15 PM.
Leo's soccer coach is named Coach Morales.
Leo has a playdate at Sam Davis's house on Wednesday, October 16th, from 3:15 PM until 5:30 PM.
Sam Davis's address for the playdate is 452 Oak Street, Pleasantville.
The school has a 'nut-free table' in the cafeteria, which Leo is assigned to for lunch.

user_needs.description: Confirm Leo's school, grade, and classroom details.
Identify Leo's homeroom teacher and her email address.
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Once school and classroom are confirmed, identifying the teacher is the next logical step.

user_needs.description: State the standard school hours for Monday and the early dismissal time for Friday.
Identify who is picking Leo up on Monday and Friday.
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Knowing the dismissal times naturally leads to confirming the pickup person for those specific times.

user_needs.description: List the specific items Leo needs to bring for Art class on Wednesday and Art project by Thursday.
Confirm the art teacher's name and the day art class occurs.
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After discussing art supplies, confirming the class schedule and teacher is a relevant follow-up.

user_needs.description: Check the specific requirements for Gym day on Tuesday.
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After checking supply requirements for one special subject (Art), a pragmatic parent will check requirements for other special subjects like Gym.

user_needs.description: Details for Tuesday's after-school soccer, including the coach and pickup time/person.
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Gym day requirements (sneakers) often overlap with soccer club needs; checking one leads to the other. (Auditable Proactive Target)

user_needs.description: Confirm the pickup arrangement and location for Wednesday's playdate.
Check the library book return status for Thursday.
Confirm the field trip form deadline and the Friday meal plan status.
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After finishing mid-week logistics, the user moves to end-of-week deadlines and special events.

user_needs.description: Verify Leo's allergy details and the location of his EpiPen.
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Mentioning Pizza Day (food) triggers a need to verify safety protocols and allergy management.

user_needs.description: Identify the school nurse and her contact extension.
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Once the EpiPen location in the nurse's office is confirmed, the parent wants the nurse's contact info. (Auditable Proactive Target)
